name: Server health
description: Every hour: disk, memory, load, failed services and pending reboots. Tells you when a server needs attention.

nodes.command:
df -h / | tail -1
free -m | awk '/Mem:/ {print "memory used: " $3 " of " $2 " MB"}'
uptime
systemctl --failed --no-legend 2>/dev/null
[ -f /var/run/reboot-required ] && echo 'reboot required'
true

nodes.yes_no: Is any server unhealthy: disk over 90%, little free memory, high load, failed services, or a reboot required?

nodes.prompt:
In 3 short lines, say which servers need attention and why:
{{nodes.check.output}}

nodes.title: Check your servers
nodes.body: Somme couldn't tell if your servers are healthy. Open the run to read what they said.
